nodes.name: Get untagged people
nodes.notes: Idempotent by design: a person disappears from this endpoint once tagged, so a crashed run just resumes and a re-run costs nothing.

nodes.name: Loop over people
nodes.notes: One person per LLM call. Batching several into one prompt is cheaper but makes a single malformed answer poison the whole batch, and there is no way to retry just the bad one.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  model: 'claude-sonnet-5',
  max_tokens: 300,
  temperature: 0,
  system: $('Get untagged people').first().json.instructions
        + '\n\nAllowed categories:\n'
        + Object.entries($('Get untagged people').first().json.category_definitions)
            .map(([key, meaning]) => `- ${key}: ${meaning}`).join('\n')
        + '\n\nRespond with JSON only. No prose, no code fences.',
  messages: [{
    role: 'user',
    content: 'Contractor: ' + $json.person.full_name
           + '\nCity: ' + ($json.person.city || 'unknown')
           + '\nYears of experience: ' + ($json.person.experience_years ?? 'unknown')
           + '\nSkills: ' + $json.person.skills.join(', ')
  }],
  stop_sequences: ['\n\n\n']
}) }}

nodes.name: Claude: classify skills
nodes.notes: Raw Messages API over the HTTP node rather than the LangChain Anthropic node, so this workflow imports on a stock n8n with no community nodes. temperature 0 because classification should not be creative. neverError:true so a 429 or 529 reaches the parser and becomes a skip rather than killing the run. Credential: HTTP Header Auth named x-api-key with the Anthropic key.

nodes.name: Write category back
nodes.notes: The API re-validates the category server-side and returns 400 on anything outside the allowlist. The flow is not the last line of defence - it cannot be, since anyone can POST to this endpoint.

nodes.name: Final tally
nodes.notes: Runs when the loop is done. Shows the category spread and every low-confidence tag, which is the queue a human should actually look at.
